# Architectural Constraints
# Generated by /plan — verified by /verify
# Edit manually to add project-specific rules

## Platform and API
- Minecraft **Bedrock Edition** only; Java Edition is out of scope [src: concept-constraint C-1]
- Only the **stable** `@minecraft/server` module, pinned to exactly `2.10.0`; no `-beta`, `-preview`, `-rc` module versions, no experimental toggles in manifests or JSON [src: concept-constraint C-2; decision-tselevaya-versiya-bedrock-1-26-]
- Version targets live in **one place** — `scripts/targets.mjs` (`MIN_ENGINE_VERSION = [1, 26, 50]`, `SERVER_API_VERSION = "2.10.0"`, `BDS_VERSION = "1.26.51.1"`); manifests, docker config and README must agree with it
- On a dependency/format error from the game or BDS: **read the error text and retarget the pack** — never loosen the API channel to make the error go away [src: concept-constraint C-3]

## Naming
- Every custom identifier carries the `andrew:` namespace (items, recipes, lang keys, texture keys) [src: decision-namespace-addona-andrew-asm-002]
- Every custom item has **both** `en_US` and `ru_RU` names in `packs/resource/texts/` [src: concept-constraint C-8]

## Layout
- `src/` — TypeScript sources of the behavior-pack script; single entry `src/main.ts`
- `packs/behavior/`, `packs/resource/` — the two packs as shipped; `packs/behavior/scripts/` is **build output** (gitignored), never hand-edited
- `scripts/*.mjs` — build, validation, BDS check; `tests/` — `node:test`; `docker/bds/` — dedicated server; `dist/` — `andrew.mcaddon` (gitignored)
- No manual packaging steps, no machine-specific paths: `npm run build` must succeed from a clean clone [src: concept-constraint C-7]

## Script rules
- Before-events (`world.beforeEvents.*`) never mutate the world synchronously — defer through `system.run`
- Scripts touch only what their task declares (auto-smelt acts only when the tool is `andrew:miners_pickaxe` and the block is in the allow-list; everything else keeps vanilla behaviour)
- No `any` in TypeScript (`strict: true`); `console.warn` for diagnostics that must reach the BDS log

## Verification split
- Behavior-pack loading, manifest/dependency errors and script execution are proven on **BDS in Docker** (channel `bds`)
- Rendering, icons, Creative placement and RU/EN names are proven **only on the iPad** (channel `ipad`) — a green BDS run never closes those [src: concept-constraint C-6]
- Auto-smelt drops are proven in a **Survival** world; Creative suppresses drops [src: concept-constraint C-9]

## Staging
- Stage 1 (Miner's Pickaxe) tasks are created only after every Stage 0 criterion is closed; ai-kit rejects cross-epic dependencies, which enforces this [src: concept-constraint C-11]

## File ownership
- `packs/behavior/manifest.json`, `packs/resource/manifest.json` — only PACK-01 (uuids are constant, never regenerated at build)
- `package.json` — INFRA-01 creates; BUILD-01 and BDS-01 add scripts only
- `.env*`, secrets — none expected; never committed
